station.name: HALCYON STATION
station.premise: Halcyon is a mid-sized software company whose entire billing system has secretly been running for ten years on one forgotten server, bill-legacy-01, executing a half-finished retry branch its author left in memory on his last day in 2016. In October 2026 the crew tried to decommission it. It did not want to be decommissioned, and one by one the people investigating it went down to Level B and stopped answering Slack.

rooms.description: Docking airlock where the player arrives. The station AI greets them here. No crew logs.
rooms.flavor: The outer door cycles for you without being asked.

rooms.description: Front desk, security station and HR noticeboard. The first room the player explores, so its logs should be relatable and funny.
rooms.flavor: A security desk, a visitor log that stops on Oct 21, and a training poster that still says 43%.

rooms.description: Kitchen and break room: coffee machine, fridge, tables, an old celebration banner.
rooms.flavor: The coffee machine grinds in the dark. The fridge light flickers. An OUT OF ORDER sign is taped to the machine.

rooms.description: Glass-walled meeting room with a whiteboard and a projector: planning, product decisions, meetings that never end.
rooms.flavor: A whiteboard covered in the words Submit, Continue, Next, Proceed and Let's go!, all crossed out but one.

rooms.description: Open-plan engineering floor: desks, monitors, jackets on chairs, a printer. Bugs, tests, upgrades, everyday engineering.
rooms.flavor: Open-plan desks, jackets on chairs, monitors still lit with Jira boards, and a printer that will not stop.

rooms.description: Ops room: a wall of dashboards, the on-call desk, a cot. Incidents, outages, alerts, support escalations.
rooms.flavor: The NOC: dashboards frozen red at 03:12, an on-call phone face down, a cot.

rooms.description: Past the loading dock, a stairwell down to a level that should not exist. Warnings, and the last recordings before someone went down.
rooms.flavor: Past the loading dock, a door propped open with a fire extinguisher. The air coming up is warm.

rooms.description: The basement room where the thing at the heart of the story lives. The reveal goes here, and the final log of the game is the last log in this room.
rooms.flavor: A single beige server tower, fans screaming, a CRT console still logged in, and a sticky note.
